description:
Query graph topology, neighborhoods, dependency paths, safe read-only SQL queries, and compact System One task slices (actions: subgraph, trace, raw, natural_language, compact_slice). Use query_graph instead of get_analytics when exploring graph topology and path traversals rather than aggregated numerical metrics.

Returns subgraph nodes and edges, upstream/downstream trace path, raw SQL rows, or compact task slice.

action.description: The graph query action to execute: subgraph, trace, raw, natural_language, compact_slice.

direction.description: Direction of dependency traversal for trace.

edge_types.description: Allowed edge types for trace (default: depends_on, blocks, child_of).

query.description: Natural language search query for natural_language action.

root_id.description: Root node ID for subgraph query.

sql.description: Read-only SELECT query for raw action.

name: query_graph
